title: Labsii Bishaan Badiisaa Guddaa
intro: Namni dhuunfaa kun jaarraa hedduuf utubaa obsa ta’ee dhaabbatee, hawaasa mormituu gara ifa dhugaatti waamuun qoosaa fi diduu isa mudate. Rakkoon guddaan fi ulfaatina ergaan dhalootaaf dabarsu ta’us, hojjetaan kun hanga labsiin dhumaa bahutti ergama isaanii irratti cichee ture.
clues: Waggaa dhibba sagal fi shantama halkanii fi guyyaa, dhoksaa fi ummata biratti ummata koo gara daandii qajeelummaatti waamuun dabarse.
Ani saba koo adabbii nama dhukkubsu akeekkachiise, ta’us garuu of tuulummaadhaan quba isaanii gurra isaanii keessa kaa’anii uffata isaaniitiin of haguugan.
Bishaan ijaan arguu baatus ija Gooftaa koo isa dammaqina qabu jalatti waan guddaa akkan ijaaru ajajame.
Yeroon hojjedhu hoggantoonni saba koo bira darbanii natti qoosan, garuu yeroo dhiyootti nuti warra itti qoosnu akka taanu itti hime.
Fooniifi dhiigni ofii koo akka natti makamuuf kadhadhe, isaan garuu gaara tokkotti kooluu galfachuu filataniiru, kunis dambalii ol ka’aa jiru irraa isaan oolcha jedhanii amanan.
Doonii koo dhuma irratti lafti bishaan ishee liqimsitee samiin rooba cimaa erga dhaabdee booda gaara Juudii irratti boqotte.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
